known.via: English Wikipedia "Coteaux du Lyonnais AOC" (redirects to "Coteaux du Lyonnais")

limits: For red and rosé wine, Gamay de Bouze and Gamay de Chaudenay together: at most 10%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A Beaujolais appellation on the slopes of the Monts du Lyonnais, west of Lyon. Wines are made from Chardonnay, Aligoté and Gamay.
